mask_policy: only unused vector slots are missing; measurement failures quarantine entire candidate

metrics.name: temperature_coefficient_per_K
metrics.definition: peak-to-peak follower output / mean output / 165 K; -40..125 C

metrics.name: supply_power_25C_W
metrics.definition: -I(VVDDdc)*1.8 at 25 C in DC follower fixture

metrics.name: follower_output_offset_25C_V
metrics.definition: V(vout6)-0.45 at 25 C; signed output error, not input offset

metrics.name: gain_at_0p1Hz_dB
metrics.definition: 20*log10(abs(V(opout))) at 0.1 Hz, 1 V AC in inverting fixture, 27 C

metrics.name: common_mode_transfer_at_0p1Hz_dB
metrics.definition: 20*log10(abs(V(cm3))) at 0.1 Hz; not generic positive CMRR

metrics.name: unity_gain_frequency_Hz
metrics.definition: first descending 0 dB crossing; log-frequency interpolation

metrics.name: phase_at_unity_deg
metrics.definition: unwrapped phase of V(opout) at that crossing; not automatically phase margin

metrics.name: rising_slew_observed_10_90_V_per_s
metrics.definition: 80% of observed output transition / interpolated 10-to-90% interval

metrics.name: falling_slew_observed_90_10_V_per_s
metrics.definition: Positive 80% of observed output transition / interpolated 90-to-10% interval

metrics.name: rising_settling_observed_1pct_s
metrics.definition: First time after last exit of 1% observed amplitude band about final measured high output; finite window

metrics.name: falling_settling_observed_1pct_s
metrics.definition: First time after last exit of 1% observed amplitude band about final measured low output; finite window

metrics.name: high_final_tracking_error_V
metrics.definition: Time-weighted final output mean over 180..200 us minus ideal 0.5 V

metrics.name: low_final_tracking_error_V
metrics.definition: Time-weighted final output mean over 380..400 us minus ideal 0.3 V
